title: Public vs. private MS patient communities
subtitle: Reddit (public) vs. Facebook (mostly private) for active MS patients & caregivers
sample: Five largest active MS patient/caregiver communities across each platform
exclusions: advocacy-sponsored communities (e.g. National MS Society official groups)
note: Public-Reddit (r/MultipleSclerosis) is by far the largest single MS patient forum. Private Facebook groups are smaller but more active per-member, especially the DMT-experience and caregiver-support groups. The DMT-decision conversations concentrate in private FB groups where patients share specific clinical experiences without public visibility.

source.notes: Hand-authored estimates for demo purposes. r/MultipleSclerosis size is roughly accurate as of 2026Q1; Facebook estimates are interpolated from public-group page sizes plus reported private-group reach. Calibrate against real platform data before shipping.
